about: Places where the Figma file disagrees with itself. The tokens follow the variables (they are what designs actually bind to); the brand team should confirm each item and fix the other side in Figma.

resolved.decision: Eyebrow is 10px (line height 16px). The Typography frames saying 12px are wrong and will be corrected in Figma.
Eyebrow colour is brand/500 (text/eyebrow). The Semantic Colours frame saying brand/600 is wrong and will be corrected in Figma.
Weights are 400–700. ExtraBold and Black are banned (typography.json).
colors.json wins. Applied as overrides in data/overrides/semantic-colors.json; #0C1927 added to the palette as neutral-light/1300. Figma variables need updating to match.
A heavy border is 2px or more; a shadow with the default 1px border is allowed.
Typography frames updated to match the variables (H5 18/24, H6 16/20, Body/MD 16/24, plus mobile line heights).
Typefaces frame updated: -2% Display, -1% Headings, 0% body.
size/eyebrow description updated to +8% (0.96px), matching the variable, text style and typography.json.
Descriptions updated: 10px floor note, radius scale 2–12px plus pill, Eyebrow style 10px.
Eyebrow is 10px at any weight; Eyebrow style and text/eyebrow descriptions updated.
Cards have borders: default container = container/primary + 1px border/container. border/primary description updated in Figma.
Mid Raised is for modals and popovers only (borders-elevation.json). Effect style and container/elevated descriptions updated in Figma.
Hover removed: the container/hover swatches were deleted from both Semantic Colours frames.

'Type Scale' and 'Responsive Type Styles' moved to a new Archive page and labelled [Archived 2026-10-09]. The typography page (Typefaces, Typography — Desktop/Mobile) is the reference. Anything on the Archive page is not a brand source.
Keep text/tertiary as #768EA7 (neutral-light/600) in Light mode. Accepted by the brand team with its 3.4:1 contrast on background/primary.
Minimum type size is 12px. Components use Role/* text styles; a Text Roles collection (Document, Newsletter, Deck) sets sizes per format. Supersedes 'eyebrow-size': the eyebrow is 12px in Document.
Cards follow the container default: container/primary, 1px border/container, radius/default, padding/container, gap/stack.
Positive and Negative cards keep a 1px border in their status colour. Replaces 'status containers have no border'.
Card, Chip and Badge use one vocabulary: Positive, Negative, Information, Neutral, Primary (no Success/Error/Brand names).

Warnings use Negative (no notice colour). Information reuses the brand blue family. Added container/info, text/info, container/info-strong, container/success-strong (green/700), container/error-strong (red/600), text/on-strong.
Buttons are squared with radius/default (2px).
Tag, Contact Pill and Button have Style = Neutral (container/inverse + text/inverse) or Brand (container/brand + text/on-brand), so they follow Light and Dark.
Components are for marketing collateral, not product UI: no hover, pressed, disabled or expanded states are defined. HTML output still keeps the browser focus ring (color.focus-visible).
Icons come from Lucide when one is asked for; no icon set is built in Figma ahead of time.
Eyebrow is 12px / 18px (size/eyebrow -> global/fz/12, line-height/eyebrow -> global/lh/18); tracking stays 0.96px, which is +8% at 12px. Supersedes eyebrow-size and eyebrow-semibold-12px.
Documents and 2-pagers are A4 portrait (794 x 1123 px at 96 dpi). Margins and section spacing use padding/section; see data/formats/document.json.

Minimum text size stays 10px, the eyebrow included (Eyebrow back to 10/16; Role/Eyebrow is 10/16 in Document mode). Body/2XS stays 10px for documents. Supersedes min-size-12-text-roles and eyebrow-12px; resolves 10px-base-styles.
Brand blue brand/500 is #1655F2. Updated on 2026-10-14 in Figma (variable, 45 unbound fills, Colours-page labels), the snapshot, tokens.json and the uploaded colors.json.
Newsletters use TASA Orbiter for headings, falling back to Inter; Inter for body. No third fallback, even in email.
Newsletters are built for Brevo: {{ unsubscribe }} link mandatory, {{ mirror }} optional, {{ contact.ATTRIBUTE }} for personalisation.
The Figma design system (served by this MCP) is the only source for every format: newsletter, deck and A4 document. No other reference material is used.

The user decides what is made (deliverable, format, purpose, audience, content, facts and scope); Claude decides how it looks (layout, composition, hierarchy, components, visualisation) inside the design system. Claude adds nothing that was not asked for and asks when unclear.

Architecture diagrams (16:9, HTML) approved: Dense / Medium / Open chosen by counting nodes, labels and zones then checking fit; each element uses a named text style per density (12px minimum, Body/2XS never used); spacing, radius, borders and colours are tokens; node = dashed box + brand title tag + icon; default arrow dashed text/secondary, data flow solid border/brand, status only when marked, other colours only when the user defines them. See data/formats/architecture.json.
Architecture icons come from the Faclon architecture icon library provided by the user, not Lucide; until it is provided, ask the user. The Lucide rule still applies to every other format.

Canvas padding: architecture 48px (spacing/48), decks 52px (spacing/52), A4 documents 36px (spacing/36) — the A4 value is the brand team's Figma page (26pt on 595 × 842 pt) converted to 794 × 1123 px. All on the spacing scale.

A4 header and default footer follow the Figma page (Design MCP, frame '5'): context label left and logo top-right (logo size may vary); footer '© Faclon Labs | All Rights Reserved' left and a two-digit page number right, in Body/XS Medium text/brand, no divider. A user-specified footer replaces the default.

A4 document spec approved: named text style per element (title Heading/H2 Semi Bold, section Heading/H4 Semi Bold, body Body/SM, caption Body/XS…), token spacing (sections padding/section, cards gap/grid, inside cards padding/container), component usage (Card default tone, max 3 per row, Metric/Icon/Highlight/Media/Profile/FAQ/Banner cards, Chip/Badge, Divider). See data/formats/document.json.

A4 page breaks: UI cards (and table rows, images with captions, a heading with its first paragraph) are never cut; if one does not fit, it moves whole to the next page. Paragraphs and lists may continue on the next page. Content always stops gap/grid above a reserved footer zone.
Deck minimum text size is 14px (Body/SM), matching the designed slides; replaces the 24px draft.
No text above 72px in decks: hero titles, closing statements and big numbers use Display/XL (72/80) at most.
Added accent-2 (#B4FF6B) and text/accent-on-brand for highlighted text on brand-blue slides (4.83:1). The existing accent (#68DD68) stays for dark surfaces.
accent and accent-2 share one budget: together roughly 10–15% of any canvas (fills, borders and accent text).
Every deck slide, hero slides included, uses 52px (spacing/52) on all four sides; the Figma slides' 70px content guide and 134px hero inset are replaced because neither is on the spacing scale.

Designed reference slides in Figma (product stack, team, page breakers, closing; more to come) keep their layout and decoration; only background colour, fonts, chips and logo placement are mapped to the design system. AI slides default to dark, asking the user first.
Decks are delivered as HTML by default; PDF or PPTX only when the user asks.

Claude never changes the user's content: no rewriting, shortening, cutting, reordering of meaning or adding. It only designs. If a change would help, it flags it, asks first and offers options for presenting the content better.

Nothing overflows: text stays inside the canvas padding on all four sides and inside its card, box, zone or node. There is no word or bullet limit; readability comes from each format's minimum font size. When content is too much for the space, Claude flags it and asks the user instead of squeezing or cutting.
The draft 40-words and 5-bullets-per-slide limits are removed; the brand team's slides are dense by design.

Page-breaker mapping approved by the brand team (Figma review frame 3069:2792 on Layouts): the Figma design stays; only background colour, fonts, chips and logo placement come from the design system, the same as the other reference slides.
Newsletter breakpoints are 600px (desktop) and 400px (mobile); side padding 24px at both; logo centred at the top.
Every image and link in a newsletter is a placeholder; the designers upload images and add links (including the logo) themselves.
Newsletters must not look crowded: clear foreground/background separation and generous spacing between blocks, all from spacing tokens.
Avoid headings over 60 characters. Claude never shortens one itself: it highlights it, offers alternative presentations and says which it advises; if the user says no, the heading is used as given.
The top of a newsletter can be a banner with the heading on it; banner + title + subheader + CTA; or title + subheader + image. Only the elements the user gives are used.

Newsletter only: outer background background/secondary, content column background/primary. The separation stays subtle by choice; it is not to be made more prominent. This does not apply to other formats.
Approved: hero title heading/h2 (32px desktop, 26px mobile), subheader body/lg (18px, 16px), CTA Role/Button; a long heading the user keeps may step down to heading/h3.
Approved: a banner carrying a heading has a background/brand cell background with text/on-brand, shown when images don't load.
Deck spec and guardrails approved by the brand team.

Opacity variables are stored in Figma as 0–100, because Figma reads opacity variables as percentages (0.32 rendered as 0.32%, making bound layers invisible). The build script divides by 100, so the MCP still serves 0–1.

The card tone 'Selected' is renamed 'Featured' (Card base and Card, in Figma and the MCP): marketing material has no selection state; Featured makes one card stand out. Same tokens: container/selected fill, border/brand border. Chip padding stays as designed.
Keep as designed: Neutral chip and Neutral/Subtle badge use container/primary, and Neutral is the default chip tone.

FAQ is responsive to the asset: Accordion Item has an optional answer (Role/Body, text/body, 'Show answer'); show answers when the asset needs them, questions only otherwise. Added in Figma 2026-10-17.

figma_updates_done: 2026-10-09: added neutral-light/1300; repointed text/heading, text/body, text/primary, text/secondary, text/tertiary, background/secondary; deleted ExtraBold variables; updated weight, size, radius and eyebrow descriptions; corrected Typography, Typefaces and Semantic Colours frames (48 labels).

2026-10-09: created Regular, Medium, Semi Bold and Bold variants for every Display, Heading and Body style (67 new) plus Eyebrow/Semi Bold; bound all variants to the typography variables; bound Heading/H1 size, line height and tracking.
2026-10-09: created Archive page; moved Type Scale and Responsive Type Styles there.

2026-10-14: added Text Roles collection (Document, Newsletter, Deck; 27 variables) and 11 Role/* text styles; added container/info, text/info, container/info-strong, container/success-strong, container/error-strong, text/on-strong; components moved to Role/* styles and the container default; Badge rebuilt (5 intents x Subtle/Intense x 3 sizes); Tag, Contact Pill and Button given Neutral/Brand styles, Button radius 2px; AI Export cards moved to Archive.
2026-10-14: size/eyebrow and line-height/eyebrow repointed to 12/18; Eyebrow style descriptions and both Typography spec rows updated; 11 Risk Evaluation cards moved to Archive.
2026-10-14: size/eyebrow and line-height/eyebrow back to 10/16 and Role/Eyebrow Document mode pointed at them; brand/500 changed to #1655F2 and the three Colours-page labels updated.

2026-10-14: snapshot re-synced from Figma (Text Roles collection, 6 semantic colours, eyebrow aliases, 11 Role/* styles) and verified variable-by-variable against Figma; tokens.json rebuilt with typography.roles.
2026-10-17: renamed the Card base and Card tone 'Selected' to 'Featured' (instances on the Dark theme section follow automatically); Card base description updated to match.

2026-10-17: updated component descriptions to match their bindings (Heading content, Body Text, Chip, Card base, Metric Card, Accordion Item, FAQ Card); added an optional Answer (Role/Body, text/body) with 'Show answer' and 'Answer' properties to Accordion Item.
